offset.description: Page number inside the requested collection. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

pageSize.description: Number of elements to display per page. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported sorts are:

+ id: Sort by primary key

+ hours: Sort by logged hours

+ spent_on: Sort by spent on date

+ created_at: Sort by time entry creation datetime

+ updated_at: Sort by the time the time entry was updated last (operations: list)

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported filters are:

+ entity_type: Filter time entries depending on the entity they are logged on. Can either be `WorkPackage` or `Meeting`.

+ entity_id: Filter time entries for the specified entity IDs.

+ project_id: Filter time entries by project

+ user_id: Filter time entries by users

+ ongoing: Filter to only recevie ongoing timers

+ spent_on: Filter time entries by spent on date

+ created_at: Filter time entries by creation datetime

+ updated_at: Filter time entries by the last time they where updated

+ activity_id: Filter time entries by time entry activity (operations: list)

id.description: The id of the time entry — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: create, delete, get, update, update_form)

spentOn.description: The date the expenditure is booked for (operations: create)

hours.description: The time quantifying the expenditure (operations: create)

ongoing.description: Whether the time entry is actively tracking time (operations: create)

createdAt.description: The time the time entry was created (operations: create)

startTime.description:
The time the time entry was started, or null if the time entry does not have a start time.

The time is returned as UTC time, if presented to the user it should be converted to the user's timezone.

This field is only available if the global `allow_tracking_start_and_end_times` setting is enabled. (operations: create)

endTime.description:
The time the time entry was ended, or null if the time entry does not have a start time.

The time is returned as UTC time, if presented to the user it should be converted to the user's timezone.

This field is only available if the global `allow_tracking_start_and_end_times` setting is enabled. (operations: create)

updatedAt.description: The time the time entry was last updated (operations: create)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
